title: Dispatch board
subtitle: What is happening right now: the loads, where they are, and who can run them.

loads.title: Loads
loads.emptyUnassigned: No load is waiting for a driver.
loads.denied: Your role does not reach loads.

map.title: On the map
map.noTilesHint: The points are where they belong and the zoom works; what is missing is the road. Turn it on by putting the Google Maps key on the server.
map.withoutSignal: {n} running loads with no position received.
map.withoutSignalOne: {n} running load with no position received.
map.withoutSignalHint: Positions come in per load, from the tracking provider. With no session open, or nothing received in the last few hours, there is no point to draw — and putting the truck where it was yesterday would be worse.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.denied: Your role does not reach drivers.

load.title: New load
load.noCustomers: No active customer to load against.
load.rest: This is what a load needs to exist. Once it is created you land on its record, where the rate, the paperwork and the rest of the stops go.

driver.title: New driver
driver.noCarriers: No carrier to tie the driver to.
driver.rest: This is what a driver needs to exist. Once created you land on their record, for the licence, the medical card and the standing equipment.

history.empty: Nothing has happened to this load yet.

edit.title: Edit {number}
edit.rest: Everything this window does not show travels back untouched. For the rate, the paperwork and the requirements, open the full record.
edit.fromLocation: The address comes from the customer’s site. Change it on the full load record.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.warning: Cancelling stops the load. The record, its paperwork and its history stay.
cancel.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. This is what gets read back weeks later when the customer asks.

driver.noTimeline: Nothing recorded for this driver yet.
